blocks.html: Join BUZZY Rewards for free and unlock 5% off your first visit. More savings and perks are just around the corner.
Must be 21+ with a valid ID. Rewards can’t be exchanged for cash. Program terms may change.

items.a_html: Fill out the form on this page, or ask any budtender at 137 Court St. It's free and takes about 30 seconds. You must be 21+.

items.q: How do the welcome discounts work?
items.a_html: You get 5% off the day you join, 10% off your second visit and 15% off your third. In store, it's applied at checkout. Online, your 5% applies to your first order after you sign up. Rewards discounts can't be combined with other discounts or promotions.
Every $1 you spend before tax earns 1 point, in store and online. Points build automatically on eligible cannabis purchases.

items.q: What can I redeem points for?
items.a_html: 100 points = $12 off, 300 points = $25 off, 500 points = $40 off and 750 points = a free product from our rewards selection. Redeem at checkout in store or on eligible pickup and delivery orders.
A free product from our birthday selection. Add your birthday when you sign up and we'll email you when it's time to pick yours.
Share your referral link with a friend. When they join BUZZY Rewards, you get 50 points.

items.q: How do I check my points?
items.a_html: Open your BUZZY Rewards pass in Apple Wallet or Google Wallet. It shows your balance and your next reward. Any budtender can look it up too.
Your points stay active as long as you make a qualifying purchase at least once every 12 months.

items.q: Can I combine rewards with other deals?
items.a_html: Usually, yes. Some brand specials and clearance deals have redemption limits, and your budtender will let you know at checkout.
